request.description:
Get list of supported MongoDB versions grouped by major version.

Used by the UI for version upgrade dropdown.

Returns versions with labels (Latest, LTS) automatically applied based on mongodb_versions.json configuration.

**Response Format:**
```json
[
  {
    "major": "8.0",
    "label": "MongoDB 8.0",
    "versions": [
      {"version": "8.0.19", "label": "Latest"},
      {"version": "8.0.19-ent", "label": "Latest"},
      {"version": "8.0.18", "label": null},
      {"version": "8.0.18-ent", "label": null}
    ]
  },
  {
    "major": "7.0",
    "label": "MongoDB 7.0",
    "versions": [
      {"version": "7.0.30", "label": "LTS"},
      {"version": "7.0.30-ent", "label": "LTS"},
      {"version": "7.0.29", "label": null}
    ]
  }
]
```

**Frontend Usage:**
- Filters by tenant plan (Enterprise shows -ent versions, Community shows regular)
- Groups versions in dropdown by major version
- Shows labels like "8.0.19 (Latest)" and "7.0.30 (LTS)"

response.name: Success - All Versions
